chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from more than one narrator, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
“Do not perform salat (prayer) in anything from it, not even a sandal strap.”

key_terms.الْمَيْتَةِ: carrion; the dead animal not slaughtered according to sacred law
key_terms.شِسْعٍ: a sandal strap; a very small leather component

ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat (prayer) while wearing something made from carrion?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding prayer in items derived from carrion. It indicates that one must not perform salat (prayer) while wearing or using anything made from it, even something as small as a sandal strap.
